title: Anatomical Heart
materials: Natural wood veneer marquetry on birch panel
story: A geometric anatomical heart constructed from precision-cut wooden veneers. This piece explores the tension between organic form and mathematical fragmentation, where natural wood becomes a structural language for human anatomy. Designed as part of the VaCa Marquetry Collection series, it is not intended for sale, but for brand expression, gallery presentation, and architectural storytelling.
